fans.title: Your fans
fans.description: Add each fan with its own Bluetooth address and PIN. Find these in the official app. Each entry must identify one fan.

pin.title: Fan PIN
pin.description: Enter this fan’s six- or eight-digit PIN, including any leading zeroes. The PIN is stored in your Homebridge configuration.

showBoostSwitch.title: Show Boost in Apple Home
showBoostSwitch.description: Start a timed boost. Turning Boost off returns the fan to automatic ventilation.

boostRpm.title: Boost speed (RPM)
boostRpm.description: Choose a speed in steps of 25 RPM. The Home speed slider also starts a temporary session.

showPauseSwitch.title: Show Pause in Apple Home
showPauseSwitch.description: Stop the fan temporarily. Ventilation returns automatically when the fan’s timer ends. Turn Pause off to resume sooner.

silentHoursStart.title: Quiet hours start
silentHoursStart.description: Optional. Use 24-hour time, such as 22:00. Set both times. A changed schedule is saved to the fan once; later app edits are respected.

silentHoursEnd.title: Quiet hours end
silentHoursEnd.description: Use 24-hour time, such as 06:00. Leave both fields blank to retain the fan’s existing schedule.

showSilentSwitch.title: Show Silent Hours in Apple Home
showSilentSwitch.description: Enable or disable the fan’s saved quiet-hours schedule. This preserves its times; it does not start an immediate pause.
